condition.common_evaluator: every method is scored by the same non-detection mass recursion (theory/path_constrained.nondetection_trace); no method is scored by its own surrogate objective

flown.note: same Monte Carlo path as Chapter 6 (evaluate_monte_carlo + mission_kpi); within a seed every method shares terrain, target trajectories and sensor-detection randomness

route_snapshot.note: one representative seed of the flown regime; the aggregate claim lives in the KPI blocks

interpretation.note: the reduced grid measures optimality gap; the operational grid measures planning-model detection; path_constraint_binding varies only the reach limit; only 'flown' is a Monte Carlo KPI comparable with Chapter 6. Never read one regime's numbers as another's. 'effort-greedy' is the same score team_planner uses, so it is the cross-chapter baseline; 'effort-map-literal' follows the raw Koopman effort map and is a separate condition.

unconstrained_fab_upper_bound.certificate: Washburn 1983 eq. (5)-(6). The reported bound is PD(e) + g(e), not the solver's returned PD: an approximate solution of the relaxation is not automatically an upper bound. Seeds whose FAB solve did not converge are excluded and counted, never silently used as a bound.
unconstrained_fab_upper_bound.note: path constraints removed; not executable, used only to measure what the path constraint costs. The bound applies to the same discrete allocation model (same detection rates, transitions, budget); it is not a bound on the physical PD of a flown route.
